items.text: Production Process Standardization & SAP Optimization
Audit and standardize operational workflows across core manufacturing modules: SAP PP (Production Planning), MM (Materials Management), QM (Quality Management), and PM (Plant Maintenance).

Establish strict governance over production-critical master data, including BOMs (Bill of Materials), Routings, Work Centers, and Material Masters, ensuring consistency across all manufacturing lines.
Streamline shop-floor execution processes, including production order execution, material staging, goods issue/receipts, scrap tracking, and capacity requirements planning (CRP).
Work closely with plant finance/costing teams to ensure smooth integration between production activities (PP) and product costing/variance analysis (FICO).
Hands-On Implementation & On-Site Shop Floor Support
Lead post-go-live optimization, module enhancements, and site-level rollouts, maintaining an active, hands-on presence on the production floor to resolve operational bottlenecks.
Provide direct technical support to key users, production planners, floor managers, and warehouse personnel during critical operational shifts and cutover phases.
Evaluate and integrate shop-floor technologies (e.g., barcode/RFID scanners, MES systems, or IoT sensors) with SAP MM/WM/PP to maximize real-time inventory visibility.
Vendor Management & Team Leadership
Direct internal team and external technical consultants to ensure shop-floor enhancements and custom ABAP developments align with operational requirements.
Develop structured, role-based SOPs and conduct hands-on training for shop-floor operators and planners to maintain high data accuracy and user adoption.
Education：
Bachelor degree in Industrial Engineering, Management Information Systems (MIS), Supply Chain Management, or Computer Science.
Experience：
8+ years of progressive SAP/MIS experience in a manufacturing environment, with at least 3+ years in a management or lead capacity.
Proven track record leading SAP implementation and optimization projects with an explicit focus on SAP PP and MM (QM, PM, or WM/EWM experience highly desirable).
Direct experience conducting on-site operational support, shop-floor walk-throughs, and user troubleshooting within factory settings.
Language Skills：
Bilingual fluency in Mandarin and English (spoken and written) is required to collaborate across regional production sites, shop-floor teams, and global management.
Technical Expertise：
In-depth understanding of production scheduling, MRP (Material Requirements Planning), capacity planning, and inventory management within SAP.
Strong familiarity with shop-floor documentation, SOP creation, and master data control mechanisms for high-mix or discrete manufacturing.

description.text:
We are seeking an experienced SAP Manager with a deep background in SAP manufacturing and supply chain modules to drive operational excellence across our production facilities. This role focuses on continuous improvement, process standardization, and shop-floor digital integration.
The ideal candidate brings a proven track record of full-lifecycle SAP implementations specifically within Production Planning (PP), Materials Management (MM), and related shop-floor modules. You will work directly on-site alongside plant managers, line supervisors, and material planners to align SAP workflows with real-world manufacturing operations, ensuring accurate capacity planning, inventory control, and costing accuracy.
【Key Responsibilities】
1. Production Process Standardization & SAP Optimization
• Audit and standardize operational workflows across core manufacturing modules: SAP PP (Production Planning), MM (Materials Management), QM (Quality Management), and PM (Plant Maintenance).
• Establish strict governance over production-critical master data, including BOMs (Bill of Materials), Routings, Work Centers, and Material Masters, ensuring consistency across all manufacturing lines.
• Streamline shop-floor execution processes, including production order execution, material staging, goods issue/receipts, scrap tracking, and capacity requirements planning (CRP).
• Work closely with plant finance/costing teams to ensure smooth integration between production activities (PP) and product costing/variance analysis (FICO).
2. Hands-On Implementation & On-Site Shop Floor Support
• Lead post-go-live optimization, module enhancements, and site-level rollouts, maintaining an active, hands-on presence on the production floor to resolve operational bottlenecks.
• Provide direct technical support to key users, production planners, floor managers, and warehouse personnel during critical operational shifts and cutover phases.
• Evaluate and integrate shop-floor technologies (e.g., barcode/RFID scanners, MES systems, or IoT sensors) with SAP MM/WM/PP to maximize real-time inventory visibility.
3. Vendor Management & Team Leadership
• Direct internal team and external technical consultants to ensure shop-floor enhancements and custom ABAP developments align with operational requirements.
• Develop structured, role-based SOPs and conduct hands-on training for shop-floor operators and planners to maintain high data accuracy and user adoption.
【Qualifications & Requirements】
1. Education：
• Bachelor degree in Industrial Engineering, Management Information Systems (MIS), Supply Chain Management, or Computer Science.
2. Experience：
• 8+ years of progressive SAP/MIS experience in a manufacturing environment, with at least 3+ years in a management or lead capacity.
• Proven track record leading SAP implementation and optimization projects with an explicit focus on SAP PP and MM (QM, PM, or WM/EWM experience highly desirable).
• Direct experience conducting on-site operational support, shop-floor walk-throughs, and user troubleshooting within factory settings.
3. Language Skills：
• Bilingual fluency in Mandarin and English (spoken and written) is required to collaborate across regional production sites, shop-floor teams, and global management.
4. Technical Expertise：
• In-depth understanding of production scheduling, MRP (Material Requirements Planning), capacity planning, and inventory management within SAP.
• Strong familiarity with shop-floor documentation, SOP creation, and master data control mechanisms for high-mix or discrete manufacturing.
